commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
90+8' Dangerous play by Ibrahim Salah (Brest). Gael Angoula blows his whistle for a foul.
90+6' Edimilson Fernandes (Brest) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Gael Angoula saw the whole situation.
90+4' Here comes a substitution. Mahdi Camara is given a rest as he is replaced by Ibrahim Salah (Brest).
90+3' 4 - 1 Abdallah Sima (Brest) scores a goal! He unleashes a shot from just outside the box after a brilliant solo run. The ball goes into the middle of the net.
90+3' The resulting corner from Sorba Thomas (Nantes) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
88' 3 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Mathias Pereira Lage sets up Abdallah Sima (Brest) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom right corner. 3:1.
87' Moses Simon (Nantes) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
85' The referee blows his whistle after Marcus Coco (Nantes) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
83' Substitution. Florent Mollet (Nantes) in, Pedro Chirivella out.
83' The manager makes a subsitution with Marcus Coco (Nantes) coming on for Kelvin Amian.
77' Eric Roy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Romain Faivre (Brest) replacing Kamory Doumbia.
77' Substitution. Romain Del Castillo makes his way off the pitch and Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) comes on as his replacement.
76' Mahdi Camara (Brest) earns the yellow card.
75' Patrik Carlgren (Nantes) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Gregoire Coudert makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
73' Antoine Kombouare decides to make a substitution. Johann Lepenant will be replaced by Ignatius Ganago (Nantes).
73' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) is substituted due to injury. Antoine Kombouare gives a chance to Sorba Thomas.
72' Looks like Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
71' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) flashes a header well wide of the left post following a lofted pass into the centre of the box.
66' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
65' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Gael Angoula blows for a foul.
63' Eric Roy has decided to substitute Mama Balde and he is replaced by Abdallah Sima (Brest).
60' Gael Angoula shows a yellow card to Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) for his blatant foul.
58' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
56' The free kick from long range, taken by Nantes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
54' The game is interrupted. Hugo Magnetti (Brest) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
53' Mama Balde (Brest) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
52' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) makes a rough challenge and Gael Angoula blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Patrik Carlgren.
49' Mama Balde (Brest) gets inside the box and tries to beat Patrik Carlgren with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.

48' 2 - 1 The ball hits the back of the net! Moses Simon delivers the corner, Douglas Augusto (Nantes) finds himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes an unstoppable shot which goes inside the right post and past the helpless goalkeeper. 2:1.
48' The referee awards a corner and Moses Simon (Nantes) goes over to take it.
46' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) picks up a yellow card.
46' Antoine Kombouare makes a switch. Mostafa Mohamed is coming on in place of Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) at the start of the second period.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Gael Angoula blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Patrik Carlgren intercepts the ball.
40' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Gael Angoula blows his whistle. Johann Lepenant (Nantes) commits a foul after dangerous play.
37' Massadio Haidara (Brest) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
34' Flag up against Mama Balde (Brest). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
31' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
30' The resulting set piece from Nantes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

27' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Romain Del Castillo flighted in the free kick and the ball found the head of Brendan Chardonnet (Brest), whose excellent bullet header sailed into the left side of the goal. 2:0.
27' Moses Simon (Nantes) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
24' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Kamory Doumbia (Brest) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Patrik Carlgren. He makes it 1:0.
23' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) attempts to find Kelvin Amian, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
21' Edimilson Fernandes (Brest) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Gael Angoula blows for a foul.
20' Gael Angoula blows his whistle and it's Matthis Abline (Nantes) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
15' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) was quite harsh and Gael Angoula didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

13' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) wastes an opportunity! He unleashed a strong shot from distance after the rebound fell at his feet. It went low in the direction of the middle of the target and the goalkeeper pulled off a save to deny him.
11' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
10' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Gael Angoula has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
7' Mahdi Camara (Brest) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
5' Mama Balde (Brest) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

1' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Gael Angoula with no other option than to blow for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brest will have the kick-off.
Gael Angoula got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
